course_name_original: Design and Economics of Power Facilities
course_name_en: Design and Economics of Power Facilities
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of energy systems (power plant, heating plant, Renewable Energy Sources systems).
syllabus_topics: Basic economic principles (time value of money, updates, depreciation, cash flow calculation)
Breakdown of profit and production costs in the energy sector
Technical and economic effectiveness of design options
Criteria of technical and economic efficiency (NPV, IRR, return) and their application in the evaluation of projects
Selection of the optimal solution, sensitivity and risk analysis
Basic questions of designing energy resources (localization, the optimal amount of power)
Parameter optimization of conventional and nuclear power plants
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
